content.text: You’ve built a course. You’re ready to sell. But Stripe, PayPal, and Teachable reject your country. This isn’t a temporary glitch. It’s structural exclusion. You need infrastructure that doesn’t depend on permission from companies that don’t serve your region. This isn’t about workarounds or hidden APIs. It’s about deploying your own commerce stack, where you control the hosting, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-2|payment]] processing, and delivery. No subscriptions. No gatekeepers. No revenue share. This analysis compares your real options for [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-pdf-guides-without-gumroad-honest-side-side|COREMERCH guide to selling]]-digital-products-without-stripe-honest-side-side|Selling Digital]] courses without renting platforms that can revoke access at will. We’ll evaluate tradeoffs, costs, and sovereignty—then show you how to choose architecture that works where you are.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Courses teachable

Conventional platforms like Teachable, Thinkific, and Podia bundle hosting, payment processing, and course delivery into a single interface. They’re convenient—until they’re not. These platforms depend on Stripe or PayPal for payments, which exclude Nigeria and other regions outright. Workarounds like using a VPN or proxying payments through a friend in the US are fragile and violate terms of service. Self-hosted solutions like WordPress + WooCommerce or custom builds offer more control but require technical expertise and ongoing maintenance. COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys a complete stack using Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments—no coding required. It’s not a platform you rent; it’s infrastructure you own. The stack handles hosting, crypto payments, and file delivery automatically. You get sovereignty without the complexity of building from scratch. The tradeoff? You manage your own domain and DNS settings. But once deployed, the system runs itself—no platform fees, no access revocation.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platforms like Teachable and Stripe exclude countries based on financial risk, regulatory compliance, or geopolitical factors. Nigeria, alongside Ghana, Pakistan, and others, is blocked not because of individual creators but because of systemic issues. Workarounds fail because these platforms actively detect and terminate accounts from restricted regions. Self-hosted solutions avoid this by decoupling payment processing from platform dependency. COREMERCH’s stack uses NOWPayments for crypto transactions, which requires no KYC and works in every country. Payments are verified on-chain, and the webhook triggers instant file delivery. This isn’t a hack—it’s base-layer infrastructure. The system doesn’t care where you’re located; it only verifies that the transaction is valid. The tradeoff? You must accept crypto payments, which may require educating your audience. But in regions where fiat gateways are unreliable, crypto is a structural solution, not a compromise.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe and PayPal process payments instantly but charge 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction—if they’re available. In Nigeria, where they’re not, your options are local processors with higher fees or unstable APIs. Crypto payments via NOWPayments charge 0.5% with no monthly fees. Transaction costs on networks like BSC or Solana are under $0.10. The Edge Commerce Stack automates payment verification and file delivery, so there’s no manual intervention. Compare this to self-hosted solutions, which require ongoing server maintenance and plugin updates. COREMERCH’s stack is serverless, using Cloudflare Workers for backend logic and Supabase for order storage. The $197 deployment fee is a one-time cost—no subscriptions. You own the infrastructure after delivery. The tradeoff? You’re responsible for your own domain and DNS setup. But the system is designed to run indefinitely without additional costs.
Conventional platforms exclude 100+ countries—this stack works everywhere.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Platforms like Teachable own your data, your customer list, and your revenue stream. They can change their terms, increase fees, or shut down your account at any time. Self-hosted solutions give you more control but require constant maintenance. COREMERCH’s stack gives you full ownership without the maintenance burden. Files are stored on Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive, orders are logged in Supabase, and backend logic runs on Cloudflare Workers. The system automates payment verification and file delivery using webhooks—no manual intervention required. You own the code, the data, and the deployment. The tradeoff? You’re responsible for loading your products into the system initially. But once set up, the stack operates autonomously. This isn’t a platform you rent; it’s infrastructure you own. It’s designed to run indefinitely without COREMERCH’s involvement.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you’re in Nigeria or another excluded region, conventional platforms are not an option—they’re a dead end. Self-hosted solutions offer control but require technical skills and ongoing maintenance. COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack is the only architecture that provides sovereignty without complexity. It’s deployed in 48 hours, handles crypto payments automatically, and requires no coding. The $197 fee is a one-time investment in infrastructure you own. If you’re selling courses, templates, or digital products and need a system that works where you are, this is your solution. The tradeoff? You must accept crypto payments and manage your own domain. But in regions where fiat gateways are unreliable or nonexistent, this isn’t a compromise—it’s the only architecture that works. Choose sovereignty over renting. Choose infrastructure over platforms.
